CheckTitle: Firewall blocks Memcached ingress from the internet
Description: Linode Firewalls are checked to ensure they block **Memcached** (port(s) [11211]) ingress from the internet (0.0.0.0/0 and ::/0).
Risk: Allowing unrestricted Memcached access from the internet exposes services to **brute-force attacks** and **exploitation**.
